items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I knew he worked with a year and something. Way across the street from each other.

ctx.x: Say you wanted to get a trombone player, you only knew his first name. How would you get him? Oh right. See him black anywhere around here. See him slim.
Anything? That's all. Never get the last name. So it was just Blind Charlie? Blind Charlie. That's all. I knew he worked with a year and something. Way across the street from each other.
